# First public preview

KumaBox runs disposable AI workloads in KVM microVMs. This preview includes a Linux amd64 host archive containing `kumabox` and `kumabox-check`, plus a matching Ubuntu 24.04 guest image. The tag, archive and image are built from the same source revision.

## Included

- Docker archive and OCI image import, shared read-only EROFS layers, and per-sandbox writable disks.
- Sandbox create, run, start, stop, remove, inspect, exec, console and logs.
- CNI networking, live NIC changes and guest network configuration.
- Live snapshots, restore, hibernate, clone, export and import.
- Managed data disks and runtime disk, virtio-fs and VFIO PCI attachment where supported by the host.
- HTTP API, in-repository Python and TypeScript SDKs, and an experimental subset of the E2B protocol.

## Install

On a Linux amd64 host with KVM, download the archive and `SHA256SUMS` from this release, then run:

```sh
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
tar -xzf kumabox_v0.1.0-rc.1_linux_amd64.tar.gz
sudo install -m 0755 kumabox kumabox-check /usr/local/bin/
sudo kumabox-check --upgrade
sudo kumabox doctor
```

The guest image is tagged `ghcr.io/kgpp34/kumabox/ubuntu:24.04-v0.1.0-rc.1`. Import it with `sudo kumabox image pull ghcr.io/kgpp34/kumabox/ubuntu:24.04-v0.1.0-rc.1`. The release draft includes its immutable digest after the image build completes.

## Preview limits

The CLI, API, metadata schema and snapshot format do not yet have a stability guarantee. Use disposable hosts and retain backups. Snapshot compatibility depends on host architecture, Cloud Hypervisor version, VM configuration and capture mode. E2B support is partial; PTY, background processes, filesystem-only snapshots and several other E2B options are not implemented. Multi-node scheduling and warm pools are not included.

See the README for the full quick start and security model.
